name: media-gallery
title: Media Gallery
description: Media in a message, in their order: images, videos and recordings. An image on its own is in a card as a video is, at its own shape (no taller than 240px, its size read as it loads where the app does not know it), its title, caption (a description, an end such as its cost) and actions under it: the app's, then copying it (as PNG) and opening it in a new tab, which every image has; more are square thumbnails, the last saying how many more, or each in its card (layout flow). Each opens a viewer of them all, copied and opened from there too, gone through with the arrow keys or its buttons, that returns focus to where it was opened (or the app's onOpen). One being made (pending, of the size or shape asked for) is a placeholder of its shape, its words shimmering with how long it has taken; one deferred loads when the reader asks (its size on the button, the app's onLoadRequest); one that could not be made or cannot load says so; the rest load as they near the viewport, an image's thumbnail over its placeholder (e.g. a ThumbHash's) standing in at its shape till it is drawn, and of its srcSet copies the one sharp enough for the width it is shown at. Videos and recordings have the same states, a video's placeholder at the shape asked for, a recording's where its controls go. A video or a recording is a card with Media Viewer's controls (over a video, under a recording), its title, the app's description, its length, actions and a transcript to open; a video at its own shape no taller than 400px, its place kept before it loads. One plays at a time in a gallery, or across a conversation in a MediaGalleryProvider; mediaProps give the app the element. On the conversation's 12 columns: an image alone at most 6, of two 6 each, of more 4, a thumbnail 3 (docs/grid.md). Its viewer's copy and open buttons are 32px beside the dialog's close, on its line.
